Help & Developer Support

Polyglot Compiler Engines

NRG Engine integrates 10 compilers: C (GCC 13), C++ (Clang), Python 3.12, Rust, Go, Java 21, JavaScript (Node/Browser), TypeScript, C#, and PHP. All compilation runs through sandboxed Judge0 CE architecture.

Universal Graphics Workspace

Access vector turtle drawings, Python Matplotlib plots, and Java AWT graphics via the Graphics tab in the terminal docking panel.

Execution Diagnostics

Compiler errors, warnings, and memory stack traces are highlighted in real-time in the Problems and Terminal docks.

Confirm Sign Out

Are you sure you want to sign out of Tanmay Verma (Developer Edition)? Your local project files, saved snippets, and editor history are securely saved.
